<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp" android:background="@color/background_color">
<!-- Хедер с кнопкой меню --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:paddingBottom="12dp">
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/buttonOpenDrawer" android:layout_width="36dp" android:layout_height="36dp" android:background="@android:color/transparent" android:contentDescription="@string/menu" android:src="@android:drawable/ic_menu_sort_by_size" app:tint="#455A64" android:layout_marginEnd="8dp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/textTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textStyle="bold" android:textColor="@color/primaryColor" android:textSize="20sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<TextView android:id="@+id/textDescription" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textColor="@color/text_color" android:paddingBottom="16dp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/buttonResetCurrent" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/reset_current_level" android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/buttonResetAll" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/reset_all_levels" />
</LinearLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp" android:background="@color/background_color">
<!-- Хедер с кнопкой меню --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:paddingBottom="12dp">
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/buttonOpenDrawer" android:layout_width="36dp" android:layout_height="36dp" android:background="@android:color/transparent" android:contentDescription="@string/menu" android:src="@android:drawable/ic_menu_sort_by_size" app:tint="#455A64" android:layout_marginEnd="8dp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/textTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textStyle="bold" android:textColor="@color/primaryColor" android:textSize="20sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<TextView android:id="@+id/textDescription" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textColor="@color/text_color" android:paddingBottom="16dp" />
<!-- Блок 1: сброс текущего уровня --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:background="@drawable/hint_background" android:padding="12dp" android:layout_marginBottom="12dp">
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/reset_current_explainer" android:textColor="@color/text_color" android:textSize="14sp" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/buttonResetCurrent" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/reset_current_level" /> </LinearLayout>
<!-- Блок 2: сброс всех уровней --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:background="@drawable/hint_background" android:padding="12dp">
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/reset_all_explainer" android:textColor="@color/text_color" android:textSize="14sp" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />
<Button android:id="@+id/buttonResetAll" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/reset_all_levels" /> </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
